pretreatments.description: Concentrated phosphoric acid pretreatment was performed on substrates at 50 °C for 50 min using 83–85.9 % phosphoric acid, followed by centrifugation and washing with distilled water to remove excess acid, followed by drying and storage.

Organosolv pretreatment involved mixing the substrate with 75 % v/v ethanol at 150 °C for 30 min with 1 % sulfuric acid catalyst, followed by separation, washing with distilled water, and storage at room temperature.

Dilute acid pretreatment consisted of mixing the substrate with 0.5 % sulfuric acid solution (solid to liquid ratio 1:10) at 140 °C for 5 min, followed by separation, washing with distilled water, and storage.
